question: Verify the status-effect / weapon-keyword numbers (Burn, Frost Vortex, Power Surge, Unstable Bomber, Shrapnel, Bounce, The Bull's Eye, Fast Gunner, Fortress Warfare, Jaws, Blazing Bolts, Pyroclasm charged shot, Memory Storm) and the Psi Intensity scaling model the calculator should use as of Once Human v3.0.x (Sept/Oct 2026).
verdict: Implement two damage families. (1) Psi-scaled Status procs: Burn = 12% Psi per 0.5 s tick for 6 s (12 ticks, 144% per stack-application; up to 5 stacks, tick damage x stacks), Frost Vortex = 50% Psi per 0.5 s for 4 s (8 ticks, 400%; 4.5 m radius; one vortex at a time), Power Surge = 50% Psi once per proc (status 6 s, Accuracy -40%), Unstable Bomber = 120% Psi per blast after 0.1 s (1.5 m radius, decays to min 50% over the radius). These cannot crit, cannot hit weakspots and ignore range falloff, except weapon/gear overrides (Gilded Gauntlets -> Burn crits; DE.50 Jaws -> Unstable Bomber crits with +25% crit rate; SN700 Gulped Lore -> guaranteed crit; ACS12 Corrosion grants Power Surge crit rate). (2) Attack-scaled bullet keywords: Shrapnel = 60% of Attack as Weapon DMG to a different random body part (same element as the weapon), Bounce = 40% of Attack per bounce (bounces to 1 enemy within 15 m then once more); both can crit, hit weakspots and suffer distance falloff, and are NOT scaled by Psi/Status DMG. Fast Gunner, The Bull's Eye and Fortress Warfare deal no damage of their own: Fast Gunner = +1% Fire Rate and +1% Attack per stack for 2 s, max 5 stacks; The Bull's Eye = Vulnerability +8% for 12 s (applies to all damage taken; Vulnerability Amplifier +8%); Fortress Warfare = 2 m zone, allies get Heavy Armor (Super Armor + Weapon DMG +20%) for 5 s. Trigger chances/conditions are NOT keyword constants - they are set by each weapon's text (e.g. Outer Space 25% on hit, Corrosion 70-80% on hit, Last Valor every 4 hits with crits counting double, Jaws every 4 shots, Abyss Glance every 20 hits with weakspots counting double, Predator 40% on hit, AWS.338 70% on weakspot hit) and 'X Trigger Chance +Y%' mod sub-attributes multiply the weapon's own chance ('based on the weapon's trigger chance'). Psi model: procDamage = Psi_eff x BaseFactor x (1 + sum StatusDMG%) x (1 + sum matching ElementDMG%) x (1 + sum KeywordDMG% e.g. 'Burn DMG') x (1 + sum KeywordFinalDMG% / 'Ultimate DMG') x (1 + sum Vulnerability% incl. Status Vulnerability) x (1 + sum DmgVsEnemyType%) x targetMitigation, where Psi_eff = flat Psi x (1 + sum PsiIntensity%) - i.e. Psi % bonuses are applied to the displayed flat Psi before the factor (every percentage bucket is additive inside, multiplicative between buckets). Pyroclasm Starter's charged Dragon's Breath is a special case: 95% of Attack dealt as Blaze Status DMG that still takes Crit/Weakspot multipliers (since 2026-02-25). Memory Storm (v3.0.6) only changes Conflicting Memories' trigger cadence (every 6 hits; every 12 hits or first after reload hits all targets in range), not Shrapnel's 60% factor. Blazing Bolts could not be found anywhere - leave null. No v3.0.x patch changed any base keyword factor; the only 3.0.x status-number changes found are Voodoo Doll ult 250% Psi and Psychic Kid Psi+5% -> Status DMG +5% (v3.0.7).

confidenceBreakdown.canCrit/canWeakspot/falloff flags: high for Burn, Power Surge, Unstable Bomber, Shrapnel, Bounce (explicit wiki sentences); medium for Frost Vortex (by analogy + 0x91 flags)

confidenceBreakdown.Psi bucket arithmetic (separate vs merge: medium-low - no official formula; community calculators and the in-game stat sheet layout support separate buckets

burn.name: Burn
burn.stackModel: tick damage x current stacks (0x91: `x = tickDamage * currentStacks`); stack cap raised by Flame Resonance (+2), KAM Crank (+1), Blitz: Burning Wrath 25% chance +1 stack on trigger
burn.triggerRule: On hit, weapon-specific chance: KVD Boom! Boom! 18%, ACS12 Pyroclasm Starter 27%, EBR-14 Octopus 50%; KAM Crank every 7 hits. No universal chance; mods/sub-attributes add 'Burn Trigger Chance %' (multiplicative on the weapon's own chance).
burn.exceptions: Gilded Gauntlets unlock Burn crits (in-game sheet shows 'Burn Crit Rate 20%, Burn Crit DMG Bonus 20%'); EBR-14 Octopus has Keyword Crit Rate +20% in 0x91 data.
source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0x91cea55/OnceHuman/gh-pages/assets/index-DXU_nBNN.js (0x91CEA55 calculator bundle v1.3.0, data dated 2026-03-05, read in full)
burn.history: Base DMG raised 10% -> 12% in the 2024-11-23 Co-Dev Update (lReDragol/OHDB mirrored text still says 10%).

frostVortex.stackModel: only 1 Frost Vortex may exist at a time (KV-SBR Icy Rain allows 2; Vortex Multiplier mod +1)
frostVortex.triggerRule: Weapon-specific: KAM Abyss Glance every 20 hits (weakspot hits count as 2; reduced to 15 per 2024-11-23 blog), M416 Silent Anabasis ~10-12% on hit, KV-SBR Icy Rain 40% on crit. Mods/sub-attributes add 'Frost Vortex Trigger Chance %'.
source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0x91cea55/OnceHuman/gh-pages/assets/index-DXU_nBNN.js (0x91CEA55 calculator bundle v1.3.0, data dated 2026-03-05, read in full)
frostVortex.history: Older sources (TheGamer, lReDragol/OHDB text) say 30% Psi per second for 4 s; both current fandom and the 2026-03 0x91 data say 50% per 0.5 s for 4 s. The buff date was not found.

powerSurge.name: Power Surge
powerSurge.statusEffect: Power Surge status 6 s, Accuracy -40% on target (Static Shock mod: duration -50%, DMG +20%)
powerSurge.triggerRule: On hit, weapon-specific chance: MPS7 Outer Space 25% (+30% trigger factor 12 s after a kill, +40% 3 s after reload), SOCR Outsider 35%, ACS12 Corrosion 70-80% (no status on non-Meta-Humans; Power Surge Crit Rate/Crit DMG +15% per stack x10), R500 Hammerhead Shark 80% on weakspot hit, Critical Pulse continuous on hit (0.5 s CD) + charged orb lightning 75% Psi; Stun Baton light attacks. Mods: Shock Rampage +5% trigger chance (based on weapon chance) x4.
powerSurge.exceptions: ACS12 Corrosion grants 'Power Surge Crit Rate +15%' stacks, implying its Power Surge can crit; Thunderclap mask: after 20 Power Surges next hit summons Celestial Thunder = 200% Psi Shock DMG.
source: once-human.fandom.com/wiki/ACS12_-_Corrosion, wikily.gg Critical Pulse 10732404, game8 Power Surge build (via search snippet)
powerSurge.history: No base-factor change found 2025-2026. 2024-11-23 blog mentioned per-weapon trigger changes (e.g. 40% on hit / 90% on weakspot for one weapon).

unstableBomber.name: Unstable Bomber

unstableBomber.triggerRule: Weapon-specific: DE.50 Jaws every 4 shots; KV-SBR Little Jaws guaranteed on hit with 0.9 s cooldown (delay +0.2 s; +20% DMG per 0.1 s of delay), SN700 Gulped Lore 80% on weakspot hit (guaranteed crit), QBJ97 Fiery Trees chance on hit (full Spark raises chance).
unstableBomber.exceptions: DE.50 Jaws: 'Unstable Bomber can Crit, Crit Rate +25%'; SN700 Gulped Lore: guaranteed Crit DMG; Reckless Bomber mod converts 1% Crit Rate -> +0.5% UB DMG (i.e. UB normally cannot crit).

bounce.name: Bounce
bounce.ticksPerApplication: 1 per bounce; bounces to 1 enemy within 15 m then once more (2 bounces base)
bounce.triggerRule: Weapon-specific: MPS5 Kumawink 25% on hit (Bounce base DMG +50%), HAMR Brahminy 60% (Bounces +2; 50% Bounce DMG to players; weakspot priority +50%), MG4 Mr Squid 90% on crit (old text), KVK 3 Bull (2026). Mods: Boomerang Bullet +2% trigger chance per trigger x10 (based on weapon chance).
bounce.history: Reworked 2024-11-23 to 40% of Attack per bounce. Pre-rework text (still in lReDragol/OHDB and the 0x91 generic table) was 60% Attack to a random enemy within 10 m; 0x91 per-weapon rows use 35%.

theBullsEye.name: The Bull's Eye
theBullsEye.effect: marks/highlights the target; Vulnerability +8% for 12 s (Vulnerability Amplifier mod: +8% more). Vulnerability multiplies all damage taken (weapon and status) as its own (1+sum) factor.
theBullsEye.triggerRule: Weapon-specific: AWS.338 Bullseye 70% on weakspot hit (and first hit after weapon switch), DBSG Doombringer 30% on hit / 80% within 5 m, DE.50 Wildfire 60% on hit (80% spread), Recurve Crossbow 100% on weakspot hit (once per target per 15 s; +15% Crit Rate vs marked for 10 s), Scout Drone (Invisible Hunter cradle).

fortressWarfare.effect: creates a 2 m radius zone; allies inside gain Heavy Armor for 5 s. Heavy Armor = Super Armor + Weapon DMG +20%. psiIntensityModel.psiEffective: Psi_eff = flatPsi * (1 + S_psiPct). Evidence: 0x91 applies Tungsten AP ammo 'psiIntensityBonus 15%' as `Math.round(Psi * 15/100)` added to the Psi stat before any factor; the in-game stat sheet shows a single 'Psi Intensity 1052' line (no separate % line); Lightning Impulse Regulator/Pulse Power Device text 'Psi Intensity +30% for 60s'.
psiIntensityModel.bucketsAreAdditiveInsideMultiplicativeBe: 0x91 `Lm()`: finalDamage = base * scalingFactor * PRODUCT over buckets of (1 + sum(stat%)/100); buckets = weapon_damage, elemental_damage, status_damage, attack_percent, psi_increase, burn/frost_vortex/power_surge/shrapnel/unstable_bomber/bounce _factor, *_final, hit_amplifier (Crit DMG + Weakspot DMG summed in ONE bucket), target_normal/elite/boss, vulnerability. lReDragol calculate_status_damage: base * (1+status%) * (1+elemental%) * (1+element-specific%) * (1+vulnerability%).
psiIntensityModel.statusVsElemental: separate multiplicative factors - Sportskeeda worked example 800 Psi x 50% = 400; x (1+0.20) x (1+0.06) = 508.8
psiIntensityModel.keywordDmgVsStatusDmg: modelled as separate buckets (in-game sheet lists 'Status DMG Bonus 128%', 'Elemental DMG Bonus Blaze 91.3%', 'Burn DMG Bonus 87%' as distinct lines; 0x91 keeps BurnFactor separate from StatusDamage). Fandom's shorthand '12% x Psi x (1 + Burn DMG Factor Bonus) x (1 + Burn Final DMG Bonus)' may fold Status/Blaze/Burn into one 'Factor' - expose a toggle.
psiIntensityModel.finalVsFactor: 'Final DMG' / 'Ultimate DMG' mods (Frostwave Wither +30% FV final, Pinpoint Strike +35% UB final, First Electrocution +35% PS ultimate) are a separate multiplicative bucket from 'X DMG +%' factor bonuses (0x91 ADR-002 / Bible 'The 113 Test').
psiIntensityModel.perStackMultipliers: Blaze Amplifier 'every Burn stack +3% Psi Intensity DMG' and Reckless Bomber '1% Crit Rate -> +0.5% UB DMG' are keyword-factor bucket additions.
psiIntensityModel.weaponVsStatusVulnerability: since 2025-12-23 Deviation vulnerability is split into Weapon Vulnerability and Status Vulnerability; The Bull's Eye's generic 'Vulnerability +8%' applies to both families.

patchHistory2025_2026: 2024-11-23 Co-Dev Update: Burn base 10% -> 12%; Bounce reworked to 40% of Attack per bounce (15 m, bounces twice); Frost Vortex trigger delay reduced; Little Jaws UB now on hit; Abyss Glance FV hits 20 -> 15.
2025 Combat Balance Adjustments (2025-05-21 notes most likely): Shrapnel 50% -> 60% of Attack; Reload Efficiency consolidated.
2025-06-17 (live 06-19): Unstable Bomber 100% -> 120%; Predator Fast Gunner 40% on hit + infinite ammo at multiples of 5; Doombringer Attack +12% x3.
2025-07-16 v2.0.1: DE.50 Jaws adjusted (details not retrieved; current text: UB can crit, Crit Rate +25%).
2025-12-23: combat-Deviation vulnerability split into Weapon / Status Vulnerability.
2026-02-25: Pyroclasm Starter charged shot Weapon DMG -> Status DMG, still crits/weakspots.
2026-07-22 v3.0.2: SN700 Finale Reverb max stacks 5 -> 4, 4% -> 5% per stack.
2026-09-16 v3.0.6: MG4 Conflicting Memories Shrapnel every 12 -> 6 hits; Memory Storm added; 0.5 s stackable Super Armor per Shrapnel.
2026-09-28 v3.0.7: Voodoo Doll ult 200% Psi + 10 -> 250% Psi; Psychic Kid Psi Intensity +5% -> Status DMG +5%; Treacherous Tides 2pc back to 12% Weapon & Status DMG.
No v3.0.x change to Burn/Frost Vortex/Power Surge/Unstable Bomber/Shrapnel/Bounce base factors was found.

alternativesToExpose: Keyword DMG % ('Burn DMG +X%') as a separate multiplicative bucket (default) vs merged additively into the Status DMG % bucket (fandom's single 'DMG Factor Bonus' reading).
Element DMG % (Blaze/Frost/Shock/Blast) as its own bucket (default, Sportskeeda example) vs merged into Status DMG %.

Psi Intensity % applied to flat Psi before the factor (default) vs as a trailing multiplier on proc damage (mathematically identical unless flat Psi additions from other sources are ordered after it - expose only as an ordering note).
Frost Vortex legacy model 30% Psi per 1 s tick for 4 s (older guides/OHDB text) vs current 50% per 0.5 s.
Unstable Bomber 100% (pre-2025-06-19) vs 120%; Shrapnel 50% (pre-2025) vs 60%; Burn 10% (pre-2024-11-23) vs 12% - as a 'legacy values' preset only.
Unstable Bomber radius decay: apply average blast multiplier (e.g. 0.75-1.0) vs full 120% at the centre.
Burn stacking: multiply tick by current stacks (0x91) vs treat each stack as an independent 6 s DoT (same steady-state, different ramp).
Crit x Weakspot on Shrapnel/Bounce/Pyroclasm charged shots: additive in one 'Hit Amplifier' bucket (0x91 ADR-002, KremaOps) vs multiplicative (OH-Calculator).
Power Surge status duration 6 s (fandom, default) vs 2 s (current formula.json) - only matters for Shock Diffusion / 'damage to shocked target' effects.
Trigger chance sub-attributes: multiply the weapon's own chance (mod text 'based on the weapon's trigger chance', default) vs add flat percentage points.
Shotgun pellets: roll the proc per pellet vs per shot (unverified; Doombringer/Netherworld text implies per-pellet hit counting).
notes: Method: egress proxy blocked all game sites; numbers were taken from GitHub-hosted datasets read in full (lReDragol weapon_list.json/mechanics.py/context_module.py, saitoh183 OHDB mod scrape, 0x91CEA55 built bundle and stat-sheet transcript) and from 15 WebSearch snippets of fandom / official oncehuman.game pages. The GitHub API/HTML tree endpoints for TeeReckzi/OHMM and 0x91cea55 were policy-blocked (403) so OHMM's loadoutEffectResolver.ts could not be read. Corrections to data/formula.json: Power Surge status duration should be 6 s (not 2 s); add maxStacks 5 to Burn with stack multiplication; Shrapnel 60% confirmed (history 50%->60%); Bull's Eye 12 s and Fast Gunner 5x(+1%/+1%) confirmed; Fortress Warfare, Jaws, Pyroclasm charged shot and Memory Storm can now be filled; Blazing Bolts stays null (no source). Trigger chances must live on the weapon records, not on the keyword: the per-weapon rules above come from OHDB-mirrored text and several (Little Jaws, Mr Squid, Brahminy, Icy Rain) are pre-2025 wording - mark them low confidence in weapons.json. Expected status DPS = sum over procs of procsPerSecond x procDamage with procsPerSecond = hitsPerSecond x effectiveTriggerChance (or hitsPerSecond / N for every-N-hits weapons, counting crits/weakspots double where the text says so); DoTs cap at max stacks x tickDamage / tickInterval while sustained.
